title: Text into a number
hints: `text` is a string, so `+` joins it to itself. You need a number before you add.
`int(text)` gives the number that the string spells.
explain: The reference is `return int(text) + int(text)`. `int(text)` turns the string `'21'` into the number 21, and `+` between two numbers adds them. Without `int`, `+` joins the two strings into `'2121'`.
